property_summary: Creating a new EmergencyOracle via newEmergencyOracle can only succeed when msg.sender equals jojoTeam (i.e. calls forwarded through other contracts where msg.sender != jojoTeam must revert).

Only the jojoTeam address can successfully emit NewEmergencyOracle by calling newEmergencyOracle (i.e., calling newEmergencyOracle from msg.sender == jojoTeam results in NewEmergencyOracle emitted and deploys an EmergencyOracle).
Calling newEmergencyOracle reverts whenever msg.sender is not equal to c.jojoTeam() (i.e., only the jojoTeam address can successfully call it).

For any caller address that is the jojoTeam, calling newEmergencyOracle(description) causes the created EmergencyOracle.owner() to equal the caller (msg.sender) in the correct contract; the mutant that passes address(this) as owner breaks this rule for some caller addresses (jojoTeam) because the created oracle's owner will be the C contract instead of the caller.
